round_note: Post-Prime Day favorites that are still moving: cozy fall layers, Korean skincare, and small upgrades for the kitchen, car and keychain.

picks.name: Apple AirTag
picks.why: Clip it to keys, luggage or a backpack and find it from your phone. One of the most-bought tracker gifts every fall.

picks.name: Fire TV Stick HD
picks.why: The cheapest way to make an older TV smart, and a perennial top seller in Amazon devices.

picks.name: OLight iMini 2 Keychain Flashlight
picks.why: A tiny rechargeable light that rides on your keys and sticks to metal with a magnet.

picks.name: Hoto 25-Piece Electric Screwdriver Kit
picks.why: Rechargeable screwdriver with 25 bits in a tidy case. A popular gift for new homeowners and renters.

picks.name: Dawn Platinum Powerwash Dish Spray
picks.why: Spray-and-wipe dish soap with a huge review count. Easy repeat purchase.
picks.query: Dawn Platinum Powerwash Dish Spray bundle refills

picks.name: Tide Odor + Oxi Laundry Pods
picks.why: Big-pack laundry pods that dropped to a low price during the October sale, a stock-up favorite.
picks.query: Tide Odor Oxi laundry detergent pods 63 count

picks.name: KitchenAid Silicone Oven Mitts (2-Pack)
picks.why: Ribbed silicone mitts with a soft lining. Timely ahead of holiday baking season.
picks.query: KitchenAid Ribbed Soft Silicone Oven Mitt 2 pack

picks.name: YETI Rambler 35 oz Straw Mug
picks.why: Insulated, dishwasher-safe and fits most cupholders. A go-to gift that rarely stays discounted long.

picks.name: LANEIGE Lip Sleeping Mask
picks.why: The overnight lip treatment that keeps topping the beauty charts. Easy stocking stuffer.

picks.name: Anua PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizing Cream
picks.why: Lightweight Korean moisturizer layered with hyaluronic acid. K-beauty is one of the hottest corners of Amazon beauty right now.
picks.query: Anua PDRN Hyaluronic Acid 100 Moisturizing Cream

picks.name: Grace & Stella Under Eye Masks
picks.why: Cooling under-eye patches sold in multi-pair packs. A long-running Amazon beauty best seller.
picks.query: Grace and Stella energizing under eye mask 24 pairs

picks.name: Hanes Women's Full-Zip Hoodie
picks.why: Classic fleece zip-up for fall in lots of colors, at a basics price.

picks.name: EverFoams Fuzzy Slippers
picks.why: Faux-fur slippers with memory foam and a non-slip sole. Cold-weather bestsellers that sell out by December.
picks.query: EverFoams women's fuzzy memory foam slippers

picks.name: Colorfulkoala High Waisted Leggings
picks.why: Buttery-soft high-rise leggings for workouts or lounging, with thousands of fans.

picks.name: FYY Travel Cable Organizer Pouch
picks.why: Waterproof pouch with sections for chargers and small tech. Handy before holiday trips.

picks.name: Stainless Steel Pet Bowls
picks.why: Non-slip, dishwasher-safe bowls for cats and dogs. A low-cost repeat buy for pet owners.
picks.query: stainless steel non slip pet bowls
